purpose: Pin the backend tree that the WHIR per-move conditioning table was derived from, separately from the Lean axiom audit in G2-VALIDATION.json.
why_unified: Only stark-backend-unified has WHIR-Y (PROOF.md:40, GAPS.md:63) and the x15 odd-domain patch. The sibling stark-backend/ tree (whir.rs sha 595f4309...) lacks both and must not be used.
notes: whir.rs is 541 lines in this tree; the line numbers in PROOF.md section 6.5 range to 326 and are consistent with this file, but the section 6.5 table does not name the unified tree explicitly.

sample_ext draws twelve independent base-field samples, so alpha, z0, gamma and mu are uniform on Ext12. Query indices are uniform on 15*2^(L-k) via sample_index_exact and use a different denominator.
